Module media.barney.contract.core
Package media.barney.contract.runtime

Class ContractRuntime

java.lang.Object
media.barney.contract.runtime.ContractRuntime
@API(status=MAINTAINED) public final class ContractRuntime extends Object
Runtime support used by generated contract checks.

This class is part of the supported generated-code API. Application code normally declares contracts with media.barney.contract.Contract; annotation-processor-generated checks call this bridge to evaluate contracts, render values, and create documented exception types.

All semantic check methods are null-safe for object values. A null value is treated as passing because nullness is outside the contract model.

  • Method Details

    • requireParameter

      public static void requireParameter(@Nullable Object value, String methodName, String parameterName, Annotation... annotations)
      Evaluates annotations applied to a method or constructor parameter.

      If a semantic contract fails, this method throws an IllegalArgumentException whose message includes the method name, parameter name, contract description, and rendered value. If a Mask annotation applies, the value is rendered through the configured mask renderer.

      Parameters:
      value - the parameter value to evaluate; null passes semantic contracts
      methodName - the fully qualified executable name used in messages
      parameterName - the parameter name used in messages
      annotations - the annotations applied to the parameter
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - when a parameter contract fails

    • requireReturn

      public static void requireReturn(@Nullable Object value, String methodName, Annotation... annotations)
      Evaluates annotations applied to a non-void method return value.

      If a semantic contract fails, this method throws an IllegalStateException whose message includes the method name, contract description, and rendered return value. If a Mask annotation applies, the value is rendered through the configured mask renderer.

      Parameters:
      value - the return value to evaluate; null passes semantic contracts
      methodName - the fully qualified method name used in messages
      annotations - the annotations applied to the method
      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - when a return-value contract fails

    • requireReturnValue

      public static <T extends @Nullable Object> T requireReturnValue(T value, String methodName, RuntimeContract contract, String description, boolean customDescription, @Nullable Class<? extends MaskRenderer> maskRenderer, long min, long max, boolean minInclusive, boolean maxInclusive, int sizeMin, int sizeMax, @Nullable String regexp)
      Evaluates a generated return-value contract with pre-resolved metadata.

      Generated code can use this lower-level entry point when it has already resolved the runtime contract kind, message description, mask renderer, and attribute values from source annotations. The original value is returned unchanged when the contract passes so generated return statements can remain expression-shaped.

      Type Parameters:
      T - the return-value type
      Parameters:
      value - the return value to evaluate; null passes semantic contracts
      methodName - the fully qualified method name used in messages
      contract - the contract kind to evaluate
      description - the generated or custom violation description
      customDescription - whether description came from a custom annotation message
      maskRenderer - renderer type for confidential values, or null when no masking applies
      min - numeric lower bound for range contracts
      max - numeric upper bound for range contracts
      minInclusive - whether the numeric lower bound is inclusive
      maxInclusive - whether the numeric upper bound is inclusive
      sizeMin - inclusive lower bound for size contracts
      sizeMax - inclusive upper bound for size contracts
      regexp - regular expression for pattern contracts
      Returns:
      value when the contract passes
      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - when the return-value contract fails
